rows.source_citation: Holzheid, Palme, and Chakraborty (1997), The activities of NiO, CoO and FeO in silicate melts, Chemical Geology 139, 21-38, doi:10.1016/S0009-2541(97)00030-2
rows.source_locator: Abstract; mean gamma_NiO(l), reported spread, 77 experiments, and source-domain limits.

reported_gamma_spread.interpretation: Reported plus/minus spread; not identified as a standard error.

derivation.premise: Holzheid, Palme, and Chakraborty report a mean gamma_NiO(l) of 2.70 +/- 0.52 from 77 experiments, relative to pure liquid NiO and simple oxide mole fractions.
derivation.algebra: For dilute NiO, a_NiO = gamma_NiO(l) * x_NiO.
derivation.units_check: gamma_NiO(l), x_NiO, and a_NiO are dimensionless.

limitations: Provisional transfer from the measured metal-saturated silicate-melt composition family to regolith-like melts.
The source abstract does not specify a numerical upper mole-fraction limit for dilute NiO.
Outside the reported temperature, oxygen-fugacity, FeO, or MgO intervals the central value is an extrapolation.

flags.description: Opt-in NiO activity estimate with reported source-domain checks and provisional composition transfer.
